Remark
[rational lattice of a torus action]

Source: petersen:page-0344 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field 1. ch8:8.4.10Let $\mathfrak t\subset \iso (M,g)$ be an Abelian subalgebra corresponding to a torus subgroup $T^k\subset \mathrm{Iso}(M,g)$. Define $\mathfrak p\subset \mathfrak t$ as the Killing fields corresponding to circle actions, i.e. actions induced by homomorphisms $S^1\to T^k$. Show that $\mathfrak p$ is a vector space over $\mathbb {Q}$ with $\dim _{\mathbb {Q}}\mathfrak p=\dim _{\mathbb {R}}\mathfrak t$.
